verdict.rationale: Algolia's InstantSearch libraries (JS, React, Vue, Android/iOS) are explicitly built for as-you-type search UIs with typo tolerance and custom ranking, and multiple independent HN comments corroborate millisecond, keystroke-fast search-as-you-type performance (RAM-first index beating ES/Solr) and praise the React InstantSearch DX. Missing for 10: a first-party documented latency benchmark/SLA number for keystroke response time.
